Together AI serves PrismML's Ternary Bonsai 27B on serverless inference with input, cached input and output all priced Free under the model ID Prism-ML/Ternary-Bonsai-27B. It is a ternary low-bit build of Qwen3.6 27B: every language weight takes one of three values with an FP16 scale per group of 128, measuring 1.71 bits per weight and roughly 9.4x smaller than FP16, and it claims 95% of the original quality (80.49 average over 15 thinking-mode benchmarks, with MATH-500 99.20, AIME 2025 90.84 and HumanEval+ 93.90). It carries a 262K context, a 4-bit vision tower for images and documents, JSON mode and tool calling, with recommended temperature 0.7, top_p 0.95 and top_k 20. Other models on the same platform are billed by usage (GLM-5.3 at $1.40 per million input tokens).
Conditions
Create a Together AI account and API key (endpoint Prism-ML/Ternary-Bonsai-27B) and call it through the OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions route; the vendor publishes no free quota, rate limit or end date, so terms can change.

VMs connect by SSH key or password with network security groups you open, 22 by default.

An open-source (AGPL-3.0) free public domain service with a GitHub repository in the hundreds of thousands of stars; its README claims over 500,000 domains registered. Registration and renewal are both free rather than just the first year, with suffixes currently .dpdns.org, .us.kg, .qzz.io, .xx.kg and .qd.je. It only registers names and delegates nameservers (bring your own DNS), so A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT and MX records stay at Cloudflare or your own authoritative DNS. The usual flow is adding the full domain at Cloudflare for two nameservers, then entering the prefix, suffix and nameservers in the dashboard, accepting the policy and, once active, adding records. Usage is visible in the settings menu of the notebook editor, at the top of kaggle.com/notebooks, on your profile and in the session manager. The savings that matter: leave the GPU off unless the code uses it; an interactive session stays alive until the 60-minute idle timeout, so stopping it yourself can save up to an hour; batch commits run every cell from top to bottom and cost more quota, and an unfinished commit should be cancelled before another is started. Archived, as the panel errored in tests on 23 November 2026. Nodaroo, a small host launched in November 2026 at nodaroo.com with machines in Frankfurt and Mumbai, released free containers on 22 November: sign in to free.nodaroo.com with Discord for one box with 200% shared CPU, 6GB of RAM, 50GB of NVMe, one slot and a German node, without a card or KYC. At 6GB it offers five times Altare's 10GB of disk and spread fast. Entry is Discord-only, with OAuth scopes identify, email and guilds.join that also join its server, and an invite link adds 100 points, 25 to the referrer, for more CPU, RAM, disk and slots. Its Discord lists recruitment tiers: Light at 18 people or 300 views for 24GB and four cores, Premium at 25 or 600 for 32GB and six, and Extreme at 35 or 1,000 for 48GB and eight. Technically it is a container panel, Heliactyl in front and Pterodactyl behind, not a bare KVM: no root or native SSH, only a web console and SFTP on 2022, ports limited to those assigned, no Docker-in-Docker and 200% CPU as a shared allowance. By 23 November the panel returned an error asking to retry or contact support, with the community reporting signup and creation failures.

Vodafone UK's London's Best Network seven-day trial gave non-customers ordering online or scanning London street QR codes a free pay-as-you-go Plus eSIM with 50GB of UK data, 500 UK minutes and 500 texts for seven days from the order date, ending at 23:59 on day seven, without changing numbers or giving a card. Launched on 6 May 2025 and taken to Glastonbury and other festivals, it was widely reposted around August 2026 for the free +44 number that receives codes. Ordering needed the device located in London, a UK contact number that receives texts and is not on Vodafone or VOXI, a postcode matching a London address, one per device and the form open 8:00 to 22:00, with no roaming during the trial. The community warns that Vodafone UK blocks EIDs readily, so keep it off a main phone. Rechecked on 22 November 2026, the page only sells SIM-only plans now with no end date published, so the cutoff is recorded as 30 September 2026.
Conditions
